title: Order the OSI model layers
explanation: The OSI model runs Layer 1 Physical, 2 Data Link, 3 Network, 4 Transport, 5 Session, 6 Presentation, 7 Application. Mnemonic (bottom-up): Please Do Not Throw Sausage Pizza Away.

data.scenario: Arrange the seven OSI layers from Layer 1 (bottom) up to Layer 7 (top).
